note:
Header banner for /pages/acetyl-hexapeptide-8-research. Replaces skingenetix-argireline-acetyl-hexapeptide-8-expression-lines-research.jpg — a working banner, not a placeholder, so this is a swap on Malcolm's preference rather than a fix.

SOURCE: the-science banner wave, concept E (refraction study), Luma candidate 01 — a plain glass slide carrying a single droplet on a graphite surface, throwing a caustic. Monochrome silver on graphite, which is exactly Acetyl Hexapeptide-8's own pearl-grey scene colour, so it lands on-system without recolouring.

EXTENDED LEFT, NOT CROPPED. The band measures 1920x440 live, needing 4.364:1, and Luma returns 1.851:1. Cropping to that aspect would have taken 58% of the height and thrown away the caustic, which is the best thing in the frame. The left half is already empty — bright content starts at x=1309 — and the left edge measures mean 24.6, sd 2.4, so the extension is flat backdrop and invents nothing structural. Height was first trimmed to y300-1300 (2.78:1) to keep slide, droplet and caustic, then the canvas grew left by 1580px to 4362x1000 (4.362:1).

A ONE-PIXEL ARTEFACT IN THE SOURCE COST TWO ATTEMPTS, and is worth recording. Luma left a bright border on column 0 of the frame: mean 31.95 against 24.7 for every column after it. extend_left nulls its join against `im[:, 0]`, so that single bad column dragged the last 40 columns of the extension up with it, producing a soft vertical edge across a flat dark field. It looked like an extension bug and was not one. Cropping x from 2 fixed it: the join now reads 24.4, 24.5, 24.2, 24.7 | 24.7, 24.9, 25.4 — continuous.

flat_backdrop is FALSE here. It was tried first, on the theory that a modelled column avoids row streaking, and it put the extension about 6 levels light. This edge is clean enough that the measured profile matches the original exactly, which is the whole point of using it. Row streaking is handled instead with profile_smooth 25.0 — the setting added to the script for this exact problem — which takes row-mean spread from 6.4 to 4.4 peak-to-peak across 1000 rows, a gentle vertical gradient rather than banding, with the join step still 0.51.

Grain was rescaled to this frame's own measured backdrop (1.285), the same guard the fine-lines collection banner needed after scatter()'s fixed sigma returned vignette falloff as grain at 16x amplitude. Extension grain reads 1.183 against the original's 1.304.

TEXT MOVES FROM RIGHT TO LEFT. The page currently sets `sm:place-self-center-end sm:text-end`, and this frame puts its subject hard right — the heading would have sat on the glass. The left third measures mean 24.4, max 45.7, which is clean ground for white type. This also matches the Copper Peptide research page, which is already left-aligned.

MOBILE: the phone band is 1.048:1 against a 4.36:1 desktop frame, so cover would have shown a slice of empty backdrop. The phone gets a subject-side crop holding the slide, droplet and caustic, with a scrim baked into the bottom for the centred text — that zone was mean 90.5 / max 225 because the caustic runs through it, and now reads 39.1 / 114.

OPTIMISATION: capped at 3000 on the long edge, quality 95, 4:4:4, metadata stripped, not compressed harder — the CDN re-encodes to WebP and a pre-compressed source hands it artefacts to reproduce.
